name: Kneeling Side Kicks on the Carriage

load.note: All springs on: the carriage is just a platform here.

summary: Kneeling side-on with one hand on the shoulder rest and the top leg long at hip height: lifts, kicks and circles with a still trunk.
steps: Kneel side-on on the carriage; tip over to place one hand on the shoulder rest.
Stretch the top leg long in line with the body; top hand behind the head.
Lift the leg to hip height.
Kick forward and back, lift and lower, then circle.

layers.title: Add a strap
layers.text: Long loop on the top foot with one light spring for resistance.

modifications: Forearm on the short box instead of a straight arm.

cautions.note: Lock the carriage with all springs.

cues:
Hips stacked, facing the side wall.
Lift out of the supporting shoulder.
The leg moves; the waist does not.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
